stories.title: 2026 Christmas and holiday events in Northeast Ohio: List of celebrations in Cleveland, Akron, Canton and more
stories.summary: Communities across Northeast Ohio are gearing up for a festive season packed with Christmas events, parades and dazzling light displays.

stories.title: Jordan Gant runs for 151 yards, Stire delivers winning kick as Akron edges UMass 34-33
stories.summary: Jordan Gant ran for 151 yards with two touchdowns, Aidan Stire kicked the go-ahead field goal in the fourth quarter, and Akron edged Massachusetts 34-33.

stories.title: OHSAA members to vote on separate sports tournaments for public, private schools
stories.summary: Ohio high school principals will vote on a proposal to separate public and private schools into distinct state sports championships starting in 2028.

stories.title: Cuyahoga County Public Library, Akron-Summit County Public Library report 3rd-party data breach led to cardholders' info being compromised
stories.summary: The Cuyahoga County Public Library and Akron-Summit County Public Library have shut down their apps after a third-party vendor breach exposed cardholder information.

stories.title: Mentor Public Schools to close 3 elementary buildings, move 8th grade to high school as part of consolidation plan
stories.summary: Mentor's Bellflower, Fairfax and Sterling Morton will close after this school year as part of a consolidation plan projected to save $17 million over five years.

stories.title: No decision on parole for man who killed 2 University of Akron students in 1986
stories.summary: A parole panel was unable to reach a majority vote on convicted killer Clint Dickens. The case now heads to a review board, which could take several weeks to decide.

stories.title: 'Back in the game': Cleveland Browns legend Bernie Kosar discusses recovery 1 year after liver transplant surgery
stories.summary: Kosar was back at University Hospitals on Wednesday, marking one year since his life-saving liver transplant by sharing his recovery journey.

stories.title: Twinsburg student accused in 2 sexual assault cases; unions, school district call for improved safety
stories.summary: A 14-year-old Twinsburg student faces juvenile charges over two separate assault incidents, including one involving a school employee, according to police.

stories.title: Perry Local Schools identifies cause of cyber incident that canceled classes districtwide
stories.summary: A cyber incident forced the Perry Local School District to close all buildings Monday. The district says there are no signs of personally data being released.

stories.title: 'There’s no excuse for poisoning our air': Cleveland City Council passes legislation to overhaul air pollution control code
stories.summary: The new legislation is highlighted by new requirements in identifying vulnerable neighborhoods and strengthening Cleveland's five-minute idling limit.
